title: Check-In Conditions for Respite and Short-Term Stays: Prepayment and Health Documents
content:
A guest of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is checked in on the arrival date only when the stay's records show the prepayment and, where the stay type requires them, current health documents. Health Services and the desk apply the conditions below.

## Retired provision

The former provision that the charge for the minimum stay — the minimum stay of the stay type times the locked nightly rate — must be paid in advance, and the rest of the stay balance by the final balance due date, is no longer in force; it is superseded by the current basis.

## Conditions in force

**A. Prepayment.** Check-in is allowed only when the payments received on the stay before arrival are at least the minimum-stay charge. The minimum-stay charge is the minimum stay of the stay type times the stay's locked nightly rate. The payments received before arrival are the payments on the stay posted from the booking date to the prepayment deadline of the stay — the day that falls the stay type's prepayment-due days before the planned arrival date — less any returned payments reinstating them. The test reads the stay's own ledger.

**B. Health documents.** Where the stay type requires health documents, check-in is allowed only with health documents dated no more than the stay type's document validity before the arrival date: a physician's report of health status, with a tuberculosis screening result where the stay type requires one, and for a Post-Hospital Recovery Stay the hospital discharge summary. The documents must be dated within the validity period before arrival. Their age is counted in calendar days from the document date to the arrival date, the document date being day 0, and a document whose age equals the validity period is still valid. The date read is the health documents date recorded on the stay.

**C. Arrival assessment.** Where the stay type provides a nurse assessment on arrival, a Larkspur nurse completes a care-point assessment on the arrival day, and the care level change rules apply to its result.

**D. Conditions not met.** A guest who does not meet these conditions on the arrival date is not checked in; the stay remains booked until it is cancelled or the conditions are met within the booked dates.

**E. Posting payments.** Payments may be posted while the stay is in booked, in-stay, completed, cancelled or converted status, a payment toward a closed stay settling its remaining balance.

## Document age: boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Stay type validity | Arrival date | Document date | Age on arrival | Current for check-in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 days | 20 May | 20 April | 30 days | Yes — equal to the validity |
| 30 days | 20 May | 19 April | 31 days | No |
| 7 days | 20 May | 13 May | 7 days | Yes — equal to the validity |
| 7 days | 20 May | 12 May | 8 days | No |

## Prepayment: hypothetical case

A hypothetical Memory Care Respite Stay is locked at 352.00 a night with a minimum stay of 14 nights, so the minimum-stay charge is 14 times 352.00, that is 4,928.00. Payments of 3,000.00 and 2,000.00 were posted before the prepayment deadline and the 2,000.00 payment was later returned. The payments received before arrival are 3,000.00 plus 2,000.00 less 2,000.00, that is 3,000.00, which is below 4,928.00: under Condition A the guest is not checked in, and under Condition D the stay remains booked.

superseded_clauses: The charge for the minimum stay - minimum_stay_nights times nightly_rate_locked - must be paid in advance, and the rest of the stay balance is paid by the final balance due date.
